blocks.content: The Universe is the infinite expanse of space containing all matter and energy — galaxies, stars, planets, satellites, nebulae, black holes, dark matter, and cosmic radiation.
Red shift refers to the increase in wavelength of light from galaxies moving away from us.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The Universe is an infinite expanse containing all existing matter, energy, galaxies, stars, and cosmic radiation.
The Big Bang Theory proposes that the Universe originated from an extremely hot and dense point called a singularity.
Georges Lemaître proposed the Big Bang Theory to explain the origin and expansion of the Universe.
Edwin Hubble provided evidence for the Big Bang Theory by observing that galaxies are moving away from each other.
Red shift represents the increase in wavelength of light from receding galaxies and is the strongest proof of cosmic expansion.

blocks.content: Proposed by Georges Lemaître and supported by Edwin Hubble’s observation that galaxies are moving away from each other (Red Shift phenomenon).
• Universe began as an extremely hot and dense point called a singularity.
• A massive explosion caused expansion of space.

items: Distinguish between Georges Lemaître (proposed Big Bang Theory) and Edwin Hubble (provided observational proof via Red Shift).
Remember that 'Singularity' refers to the extremely hot and dense initial point of the Universe before the Big Bang.
Red Shift (increase in wavelength of light from distant galaxies) is heavily tested as the primary evidence for the expanding Universe.

blocks.content: Red shift refers to the increase in wavelength of light from galaxies moving away from us. It is the strongest evidence that the universe is expanding.
